description: Connect VesselTwin to ask ChatGPT about the boat records you already keep. New to VesselTwin? Visit vesseltwin.io to create a free account, then select Connect and sign in. Basic access shows approved boat, maintenance, equipment, and document metadata. Owner Pro customers can separately opt in to let ChatGPT read private records, including extracted document text, for boats they own. An optional second permission lets ChatGPT send proposed notes, checklists, maintenance entries, and measurements to the VesselTwin Inbox for owner review. Nothing becomes a saved record until the owner accepts it, and customers can turn either permission off at any time. Photo files and private records from collaborator-only boats are never included.

defaultPrompt: What maintenance items on my boat need attention?
